Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied ecological principles by rejecting “producers” on the basis that some animals don’t eat them directly, overlooking that all animals depend on producers indirectly via food chains. It then incorrectly assumed “salt water” is a universal requirement, despite many beach animals not needing salt water specifically. This misprioritization of survival factors led to selecting C instead of the correct B and prematurely marking the task complete.
